units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 14:1">Ex. R. s. 14</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>וימש</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 10:21">Ex. X, 21</cite>) <he>שהיה בו מ׳</he> there was substance in the darkness (it was thick).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 67a:7">Ab. Zar. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>כל שטעמו ומַמָּשׁוֹ אסור</he> anything the taste of which (in a mixture) as well as its substance is forbidden.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 67b:1">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>טעמו ולא ממשו אסור</he> a mixture in which there is the taste of a forbidden thing whose substance, however, is not visible, is forbidden.

<cite ref="Chullin 108a:3">Ḥull. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>טעמו ולא ממשו בעלמא דאורייתא</he> that a forbidden substance should ritually affect a mixture in which is left a taste after its removal, is in all cases a Biblical rule.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 63b:19">Snh. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>יודעין … שאין בו מ׳ וכ׳</he> the Israelites knew very well that there is no reality in idols, yet they worshipped them for the sake of being permitted public licentiousness.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 83b:20">B. Kam. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>עין מ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M01651"><he>מָמוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 83b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>מיתה מ׳</he> actual putting to death.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a:12">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00072"><he>דָּבַק</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:5:19">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מַשְׁמָשָׁהּ קיים</he> its substance remains (on the skin, even if dried up).
